url.description: The URL that was checked (the one you supplied, or the one found in the sitemap or crawl).

category.description: Result class: ok (final answer below 400, no redirect), redirect (one or more redirects, final answer below 400), 4xx, 5xx, error (no answer, or a redirect loop) or robots_blocked (skipped because robots.txt disallows it).

statusCode.description: HTTP status code of the final response, or null if there was no HTTP answer.

finalUrl.description: The URL where the redirects ended (the URL itself if there was no redirect), or null if the check was skipped.

redirectChain.description: One entry per redirect hop, in order, as {status, url}: url is the address that answered with the redirect status. Empty if there was no redirect.

redirectLoop.description: true if the redirects loop or exceed 10 hops.

error.description: Plain reason for a failed check: dns_failure, connection_refused, connection_reset, connect_timeout, tls_error, other, a redirect problem, or "disallowed by robots.txt". Null otherwise.

responseTimeMs.description: Time in milliseconds for the whole check, including every redirect hop. Null when skipped.

contentType.description: Content-Type of the final response without parameters (for example text/html), or null.

sources.description: Crawl mode only: up to 20 pages that link to this URL, each as {sourceUrl, anchorText}. Empty in list and sitemap mode.
